notes: B-106 (gate R5-14), the dealer filter of the step's grouping. Printed: 'Whenever one or more Cats you control deal combat damage to a player, destroy up to one target artifact or enchantment that player controls.' The Dog's damage row to seat 1 is journalled before the Cats' rows in the same combat damage step. The one trigger is counted over the Cats' rows only, so it still triggers once: the Relic dies, the Charm stays. Seat 1 takes 2 + 2 + 2 (20 -> 14). Counted over every row to the player, the Dog's row would be the step's first and no Cat row would trigger. Found by the fresh-eyes review of the fix.
